history.summary: A 377 sqft shoebox 1BR at $1,936 PSF in D12 Balestier, anonymously listed with no project name, no built year, and no URA data. A tiny mosquito unit far from MRT (1.15km/14min walk) with no liquidity or appreciation evidence — pure speculation.
history.rating_rationale: 377 sqft shoebox is the most oversupplied, weakest-resale unit type in SG; $1,936 PSF is steep for D12 Balestier with no MRT proximity. Generic unnamed listing means no project track record, no URA txn count, score_1000 only 489 and a weak 81-224-10 arena record (elo 856). Nothing here supports an investment buy.
